skills.name: Basic Fraction Subtraction
skills.definition: Subtracting fractions or mixed numbers with common denominators without requiring regrouping or borrowing.

skills.name: Finding Common Denominators
skills.definition: Identifying a common denominator and converting fractions with unlike denominators to equivalent fractions.

skills.name: Handling Whole Numbers
skills.definition: Subtracting whole numbers from mixed numbers, or converting a whole number into a fraction/mixed number to perform subtraction.

skills.name: Regrouping/Borrowing
skills.definition: Borrowing from the whole number part of a mixed number because the fractional part being subtracted is larger than the starting fractional part.

skills.name: Simplifying Improper Fractions in Mixed Numbers
skills.definition: Interpreting or converting mixed numbers that contain improper fractions (e.g., 2 3/2 or 1 4/3) into standard form before or during subtraction.
